Position Description

We are seeking a Senior DevOps Engineer with a minimum of 5 years of experience in cloud infrastructure, automation, and DevSecOps practices. The successful candidate will be responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing secure, scalable, and resilient AWS cloud environments while driving automation through Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD best practices. This role requires strong expertise in AWS architecture, Terraform, GitLab CI/CD, Python development, cloud security, observability, and platform engineering.

Your future duties and responsibilities

  • Design and architect secure, scalable, and highly available AWS infrastructure solutions.
  • Implement and manage AWS Landing Zone, multi-account strategies, and cloud governance frameworks.
  • Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, following modular and reusable design principles.
  • Build, manage, and optimize CI/CD pipelines using GitLab and GitLab CI/CD.
  • Develop automation tools and operational scripts using Python.
  • Implement and support containerized and serverless architectures leveraging AWS Fargate, Lambda, and other cloud-native services.
  • Design and maintain AWS networking and security solutions, including Transit Gateway, IAM, WAF, KMS, AWS Config, and Network Firewall.
  • Drive DevSecOps initiatives by integrating security controls into the software development lifecycle.
  • Implement shift-left security practices, including SAST, SBOM generation, vulnerability management, and compliance controls.
  • Configure and manage monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability platforms such as CloudWatch, Splunk, Prometheus, Grafana, Alertmanager, PagerDuty, and Dynatrace.
  • Collaborate with development, security, and operations teams to ensure platform reliability, security, and operational excellence.
  • Troubleshoot complex infrastructure, deployment, performance, and security issues across cloud environments.

Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role

  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, Platform Engineering, or a related field.
  • Strong experience engineering and architecting AWS infrastructure solutions.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS Landing Zone, AWS networking and security services, and AWS multi-account strategies.
  • Extensive knowledge of Terraform Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles, design, and implementation.
  • Strong hands-on experience with GitLab and GitLab CI/CD pipeline development and administration.
  • Proven experience developing high-quality automation solutions and scripts using Python.
  • Thorough understanding of AWS services including Fargate, Lambda, S3, WAF, KMS, Transit Gateway, IAM, AWS Config, Inspector, and related cloud-native services.
  • Experience designing, implementing, and supporting containerized and serverless architectures.
  • Experience with SIEM and observability solutions, preferably Dynatrace.
  • Hands-on experience with DevSecOps practices, including Shift-Left Security, SBOM, SAST, and AWS Security and Compliance services such as AWS Config, Inspector, and Network Firewall.
  • Strong knowledge of logging, monitoring, and alerting best practices using CloudWatch, Splunk, Prometheus, Grafana, Alertmanager, and PagerDuty.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams.

What you’ll find at CGI:

  • Employee Share Purchase Plan

Invest alongside CGI through a share purchase plan that is partially co-funded by the company. You can access your investment whenever you choose.

  • Healthcare & Insurance Coverage

You and your family are covered through a healthcare and dental subscription, along with life insurance that includes medical coverage for your children.

  • Practical Benefits, Easy to Use

Our online benefits platform brings everything together in one place—from meal vouchers and tickets to medical services, online courses, and access to hobby and leisure activities.

  • Learning That Matches Your Interests

Use CGI Academia, our internal learning platform, to build skills relevant to your role and future plans. You can also learn up to nine languages through goFLUENT, included in the platform.

  • Confidential Mental Health Support

Through the Member Assistance Program (MAP), you have access to confidential professional support for both personal and work-related situations, available at no cost.

  • Books Delivered to the Office

With Bookster, you can borrow from a modern public library, with books delivered directly to the office.

  • Referral Program

If you recommend someone who joins CGI, you’ll receive a referral bonus—our way of thanking you for helping us grow the team.

  • Volunteering, When You Choose

CGI for Good connects you with volunteering initiatives where you can contribute to causes that matter to you.

  • Time Off

Annual leave ranges from 21 to 26 days, depending on your level of seniority.

  • Office Location

Our Bucharest office is close to Grozavesti metro station, offering easy access and a calm working environment.

  • Hybrid Work Model

We work in a hybrid setup, combining time at the office with the flexibility of working remotely.

Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.

Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…

You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.

Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.

You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.

That same commitment to fairness extends to how we use technology. To support our recruitment team, AI tools may be used to help assess applications though they never replace human judgement. All hiring decisions remain entirely in the hands of our recruitment professionals.

Come join our team—one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world.
